annotations.title: Plan scenes for a design-approved overlay pack

description: Requires an approved AlertForge account connection. OAuth-aware clients should start AlertForge's secure authorization flow and ask the user only to sign in and approve. Setup: https://alertforge.ai/ai-agents#agent-setup. Normalizes and prices scenes to add to a DESIGN-APPROVED project WITHOUT spending any credits or creating anything. Requires `projectId` from a project whose Style Sheet has been approved via approve_design_sheet -- every scene inherits that project's approved look (visual identity comes entirely from the Style Sheet; there is no theme/reference input here anymore). Calling this without a valid approved projectId returns a structured `design_sheet_required` error (with the product's 3 onboarding questions and the exact tool sequence to follow) instead of guessing a theme -- see plan_design_sheet. Returns a planId (valid 24 hours, single-use) plus the exact credit cost and a human-readable summary -- SHOW that summary and cost to the user and get their confirmation before calling create_overlay_pack with this planId. Call list_scene_kinds first to see which scene kinds are creatable -- including alert-pack, which crops the identity from this project's Style Sheet and creates the selected production overlay alerts, plus the four sheet-pack kinds (panel-pack, label-pack, sub-badge-pack, emote-pack): each sheet kind renders ONE themed sheet and crops it into individual tile PNGs (a Twitch panel set, activity-feed labels, subscriber badges, or channel emotes) -- pass per-tile overrides via `tileTexts` on that scene entry; list_scene_kinds' `tileInputs` reports each kind's exact slot count and whether labels are locked to fixed vocabulary.

durationSec.description: Default animation length in seconds for scenes that don't set their own.

imageQuality.description: Default quality for scenes that don't set their own.

projectId.description: A design-approved project id -- from create_design_sheet, after approve_design_sheet has succeeded on it. Required.

scenes.description: The scenes to include. Call list_scene_kinds first -- this tool rejects any kind that isn't creatable.

alertTier.description: alert-pack only. Production overlay-pack render tier shared by its selected alerts. Defaults to standard.

alerts.description: alert-pack only. Omit for all seven production overlay alerts, or list only the alert types to generate (for example one donation entry). The character is cropped automatically from this project's approved Style Sheet.

miniPrompt.description: Creative direction for this alert, up to 160 characters.

animationPrompt.description: Optional plain-English animation request when useAiAnimation is true. AlertForge interprets it against the rendered scene and writes the protected video-model prompt; this text is never forwarded verbatim.

cutouts.description: Rectangular regions on the 1920x1080 canvas where the streamer's own content shows through. Omit to use the scene kind's defaults.

kind.description: A creatable scene kind from list_scene_kinds.

miniPrompt.description: Scene-specific prompt detail layered on top of the pack theme.

selected.description: Whether this scene renders. Defaults to true.

tileTexts.description: Sheet-pack kinds only (panel-pack/label-pack/sub-badge-pack/emote-pack) -- per-tile overrides, position-matched (item 0 = tile 1, item 1 = tile 2, ...). A short or omitted list is padded with AlertForge's own defaults; items past the kind's fixed slot count (see list_scene_kinds' `tileInputs.slotCount` -- panel-pack 20, label-pack 4, sub-badge-pack 6, emote-pack 8) are dropped -- these are fixed-cardinality sheets, not add/remove. sub-badge-pack ignores `label` entirely (fixed Twitch tier vocabulary; only `enabled` applies there -- see `tileInputs.labelsLocked`).

enabled.description: Defaults true. A disabled tile still renders on the sheet but is excluded from the ZIP export.

iconName.description: A Phosphor icon component name (e.g. "Heart", "Trophy", "DiscordLogo"). Falls back to that slot's default icon when omitted.

label.description: Up to 80 characters. Ignored for sub-badge-pack.
